title: Mobile Engineer - React Native (Paris or Remote France)
description:
About Alma 

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

About the team 

The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement.

Alma Wallet builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets.

Consumer Engagement drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently.

In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth.

This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to Gautier Labarre , Engineering Manager .

This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France. 

About the job 

- Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences: Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers.

- Make payments simple and secure: Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage.

- Raise the quality bar of the app: Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements.

- Help the team learn and move forward: Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team’s architecture, tooling and release processes.

You will work with 

- Mobile: Expo / EAS, Expo Router, React Native, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, react-hook-form, Zod, Reanimated, Unistyles, MMKV, Nitro modules.

- Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro.

- Payments: Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com SDKs.

- Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature.

- Back-end: Python, FastAPI.

- Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude.

About you 

To succeed in this job 

- You have 3+ years of experience building mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript , with experience releasing apps on both the App Store and Google Play.

- You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching.

- You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance.

- You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment.

And it will be nice if you also 

- Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications.

- Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale.

- Are comfortable challenging product or back-end implementation when it does not provide the best user or technical outcome.

- Have experience with web development in addition to mobile development.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience. 

What's in it for you 

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

- Work on products at the heart of Alma's strategy, including the Alma card, new payment methods in the app and our loyalty programme.

- Solve real mobile fintech challenges involving payment SDKs, Apple Pay, Google Pay, biometrics and secure storage.

- Use a modern mobile stack based on Expo 57, React Native’s New Architecture, React 19, TypeScript 7, Reanimated 4 and Nitro modules.

Compensation & benefits 

- Competitive salary based on 12 months

- Profit-sharing and employee savings plan

- Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package

- Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma

- Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities

- Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.

- Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)

- Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma

- Mental health: free access to MindDay platform

- Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)

- Access to our Learning & Development Platform

- 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

Interview Process 

- Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation and present you the role.

- Video call with your future manager to deep dive into the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.

- Live testing session with members of the Mobile Engineering team to assess your practical knowledge and approach to mobile development.

- Coffee Chat with members of the squad you would join , with the panel adapted to Alma Wallet or Consumer Engagement.

Diversity & Inclusion 

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Realtime & Voice) Customer Experience Platform
description:
About the Role 

HTS Assist is Hopper 's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the world's largest travel brands. We're looking for a senior full stack engineer to anchor this product, owning the realtime and voice layer end to end while building across React/TypeScript front ends, Scala and Python services, and cloud infrastructure. The team is lean and senior, ownership is broad, and the path from your code to a traveler's phone call is short.

What would your day-to-day look like 

- 
Own the voice channel end to end, including telephony and CPaaS integrations (e.g., Twilio, Amazon Connect), streaming speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines, realtime model orchestration, and latency and quality budgets

- 
Build product features across the stack, including web chat front ends in React/TypeScript, backend services in Scala and Python, and infrastructure on GCP

- 
Design for multi-tenant scale, with one codebase serving many partners through configuration rather than forks

- 
Build the safety and compliance plumbing enterprise partners audit, including guardrails, content filtering, and PII redaction integration points

- 
Keep revenue-critical deployments healthy through observability, alerting, incident response, and SLA performance

-

title: Senior Full Stack
description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia

URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.

You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.

The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. 

You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. 

The Role 

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.

You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.

Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Ownership and delivery 

- 
Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.

- 
Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.

- 
Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.

Craft and quality across the stack 

- 
Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.

- 
Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.

- 
Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.

- 
Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.

Working with product and design 

- 
Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.

- 
Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.

- 
Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.

Raising the bar 

- 
Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.

- 
Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.

- 
Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.

AI as core leverage 

- 
Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.

About You 

You will thrive in this role if you:

- 
Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.

- 
Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.

- 
Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.

- 
Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. 

- 
Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.

- 
Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.

- 
Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.

- 
Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.

- 
Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.

- 
Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.

- 
Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.

- 
Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.

- 
Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.

- 
Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

- 
Nice to have: 

- 
Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.

- 
Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.

- 
Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.

This Role Is NOT 

- 
A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.

- 
A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.

- 
A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.

- 
A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA
team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your
tests, or own your performance regressions.

- 
A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.

- 
A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.

The Team 

We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. description:
Wir suchen Senior Developer, die in unserem vollständig remoten Team an unseren Agenten arbeiten. Wenn du Komplexität magst und willst, dass deine Arbeit wirklich etwas bewegt, passt du zu uns.

Über uns 
Hausverwalter.ai ist eine All-in-One-Plattform für Hausverwaltungen, mit Funktionen wie Inbox, CRM, Dokumenten, Telefonie, Video Calls, Team Chat und KI-Agenten. Unsere Mission ist es, alles zu automatisieren, was ein Hausverwalter tut.

Über die Rolle 
Unsere Plattform ist von Tag eins an agentisch gedacht. Bevor wir überhaupt die UI geplant haben, haben wir geplant, wie Agenten mit der Software arbeiten. Denk dran – unser Ziel ist, die ganze Branche zu automatisieren, und das meinen wir ernst.
Heute gibt es für fast alles, was der Nutzer in der UI machen kann, ein Agenten-Tool, und der Co-Pilot (der tägliche Assistent des Nutzers) kann alles für ihn übernehmen, sogar den Dark Mode an- und ausschalten.
Aber der Co-Pilot ist erst der Anfang. Die eigentliche Herausforderung sind die autonomen Agenten. Dazu unten mehr.

Woran du arbeiten wirst 

- Inbox-Agents: Autonome Agenten, die anspringen, sobald in einem Ticket etwas Neues passiert. Kunden trainieren sie selbst ODER nehmen einfach eine der Vorlagen, die du für sie baust. Diese Agenten können heute schon komplette komplexe Abläufe allein übernehmen und sind einer der Hauptgründe, warum sich Kunden für unsere Software interessieren. Aber wann sollte ein Agent an einen Menschen abgeben, statt selbst zu Ende zu machen? Wie stellen wir sicher, dass er sich an den Prozess hält? Das sind deine Fragen.

- Harness Engineering: Der Agent hat über 100 Tools. Aber er muss eine Anfrage so verstehen, wie ein Hausverwalter sie versteht, und nicht so, wie die Begriffe außerhalb der Branche klingen. Was gehört in den System Prompt, was in Skills?

- Knowledge Base: Unsere Plattform hat eine eigene Knowledge Base, ähnlich wie Notion. Komplett selbst gebaut und gedacht als kollektives Gehirn des Unternehmens. Aber sollte die KI auch von selbst „lernen"? Und wenn ja, wann? Und wie machen wir die Suche in der Knowledge Base besser — über bessere Tools, System Prompts oder Skills?

- Voice-Agents: Dieselben Agenten, nur am Telefon — auf LiveKit gebaut, die Anrufe genauso abwickeln wie unsere Text-Agenten Tickets.

- LLM Infrastructure. Das richtige Modell für die jeweilige Aufgabe wählen, per Caching und Streaming die Latenz drücken, bei Provider-Ausfällen sauber neu versuchen, Context kompakt halten, die RAG-Suche optimieren, Usage über alle Provider tracken, Kosten senken und mit Evals prüfen, was wirklich besser ist.

Unser minimalistischer Tech Stack 
Alles ist TypeScript. Vom Datenbankschema bis ins Frontend.
Backend: Convex (Datenbank & Serverless Functions)
Frontend: Next.js , React, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
Technologien, die dir begegnen werden: Vercel AI SDK, Convex Agent Component

Gehalt 

5000 – 6000 Euro brutto, mit Raum für Wachstum und Beförderungen in den kommenden Monaten und Jahren

Benefits 

- 100 % remote

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten

- So viele KI-Tokens, wie du brauchst

- Wir sind eigenfinanziert und profitabel (und verbrennen kein VC-Geld, um zu überleben)

- Kleines Team, echte Verantwortung — was du baust, geht auch wirklich live

- Schnelle Entscheidungen, keine sinnlosen Meetings und keine Freigabeschleifen, durch die du dich kämpfen musst

Unsere Werte 

- Dinge fertig machen, jeder Tag zählt

- Transparenz und Ehrlichkeit, gerade wenn es unangenehm wird

- Nach Großem streben – dich und andere ständig fordern

Wenn du genauer sehen willst, was wir bauen: Schau auf unserem YouTube-Kanal vorbei — kleiner Hinweis, der ist auf Deutsch.

Du bist 

- fließend in Englisch und Deutsch

- ein erfahrener Entwickler mit mehr als 2 Jahren Erfahrung im Bauen von Agenten für den Produktivbetrieb

- AI-native. Du hast agentische Features ausgeliefert, auf die sich echte Nutzer verlassen, und du hast eine Meinung zu Retrieval, Evals, Tool-Design und dazu, wo die heutigen Spitzenmodelle an ihre Grenzen kommen.

- in erster Linie Builder. Du bringst lieber heute eine grobe v1 raus, als drei Wochen lang die perfekte zu planen.

- auf dem neuesten Stand bei neuen KI-Modellen und der Forschung

- jemand, der fast seinen gesamten Code mit KI schreibt

- es gewohnt, autonom zu arbeiten und volle Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben zu übernehmen

- unter Leistungsdruck sogar noch besser

- schnell darin, Neues zu lernen, und siehst dich als Generalist, nicht als Spezialist

Dein Techstack :

Ist nicht wichtig, da bei uns KI deinen Code schreiben wird.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.

We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. What You'll Do

Who You Are

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue. 

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

Nice to Have 

Nice to Have

Responsibilities & Mandates

All in on agentic development

Practical engineering

TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. Hiring and empowering the very best

The technical voice in new business

Hardware sense

Culture

description:
NetDocuments is committed to providing an excellent candidate experience and will never ask you to engage in recruitment activity without phone, video, and in person meetings and communications from emails using the @netdocuments.com domain. About NetDocuments 

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

- Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies

- Five-time Top Workplace USA winner

- Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do 

NetDocuments is seeking a Staff Full Stack Software Engineer to play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our next-generation document management systems. As a senior technical leader, you’ll drive the design, architecture, and delivery of scalable, event-driven platforms that power mission-critical frontend and backend solutions for our global customer base. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of backend architecture, cloud-native infrastructure, and full stack development—someone who builds production-ready applications at scale while guiding teams toward technical excellence. You’ll collaborate with product, design, and engineering leadership to define the direction of our systems and integrate cutting-edge technologies, including AI-driven services and event-based data pipelines. 

If you’re passionate about building resilient systems, mentoring engineers, and driving innovation in how organizations manage and interact with their documents, this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact. 

You will: 
Technical Leadership & Architecture 

- Set technical direction for our document content extraction and transformation team, establishing patterns for scalable, secure, and performant systems on AWS. 

- Lead architectural decisions that use OCR technologies such as Tesseract and Apryse OCR. 

- Drive initiatives that improve scalability, performance, and reliability of the product while considering and implementing changes that control costs without impacting customer satisfaction. 

- Guide the evolution of our content extraction and transformation technology stack as the business and customer needs mature and scale. 

- Make critical technical decisions that balance user experience, performance, security, and maintainability. 

Product Design and Build 

- Design and implement event-driven architectures using AWS services, Kafka, and modern data pipelines. 

- Build production-grade applications across C#/.Net, AWS services, and document extraction/transformation technologies. 

- Design and implement scalable APIs (REST, GraphQL) that power our front-end and enable third-party integrations. 

- Integrate AI-driven services and emerging technologies to enable greater backend efficiencies and increase customer productivity. 

- Build the product to enable seamless, scalable, and flexible semantic search capabilities. 

- Ensure security, performance, and compliance considerations are applied across all implementations. 

Problem Solving & Ownership 

- Solve complex technical challenges from real-time customer experiences and issues to event-driven document processing at scale. 

- Take full ownership of initiatives from concept through production and ongoing evolution. 

- Make sound architectural decisions by weighing trade-offs with reasoning that stands up over time. 

- Proactively identify and address technical debt before it impacts the team. 

Build and Optimize Systems 

- Write high-quality, well-tested code across the full stack with emphasis on maintainability. 

- Design resilient systems that maintain uptime and performance as we scale globally. 

- Implement observability through logging, metrics, and telemetry to proactively triage issues. 

- Monitor and optimize performance at scale, identifying bottlenecks and implementing solutions. 

- Create comprehensive technical documentation including architectural diagrams and design decisions. 

Collaboration & Mentorship 

- Partner closely with product management to translate requirements into technical solutions. 

- Mentor engineers across experience levels, elevating technical skills and best practices. 

- Collaborate with Platform Services, Ops, and other teams on integration points and shared infrastructure. 

- Build consensus on technical approaches while having authority to make final decisions when needed. 

- Lead knowledge-sharing initiatives through code reviews, design discussions, and documentation. 

Continuous Learning & Innovation 

- Stay at the forefront of content extraction and transformation technologies and industry trends, cloud-native architectures, and AI-powered tools. 

- Research and prove out new technologies through POCs that align with product strategy. 

- Contribute ideas that directly improve engineering velocity and quality. 

What You’ll Need to Be Successful 

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field—or equivalent experience. 

- 8+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production-grade applications at scale on cloud platforms. 

- 5+ years in technical leadership and development roles using OCR technologies. 

- Proven track record of building scalable applications still in production. 

- Required Technical Knowledge 

- Expert proficiency in C#/.NET. 

- Expert proficiency with OCR technologies such as Tesseract or Apryse 

- Expert proficiency building event-driven, microservice-based products 

- Expert proficiency developing on cloud platforms, preferably AWS 

- Expert proficiency with Kafka or similar event streaming platforms 

- Expert proficiency in observability, including logging, metrics, tracing, telemetry, preferably with DataDog 

What Will Make You Stand Out 

- Deep experience building with OCR & Text Extraction technologies. 

- Deep experience building document management or enterprise content management 

- Deep knowledge of event-driven architectures. 

- You know what it means and takes to ingest millions of documents an hour into a SaaS based document management platform 

- Track record of developing high-performance content extraction and transformation products at scale. 

- Legal industry expertise or experience with B2B SaaS in regulated industries. 

- Experience integrating AI services and emerging technologies into production systems. 

What You’ll Love About NetDocuments 

- The People! 

- 90% healthcare premiums company covered 

- HSA company contribution 

- 401K match at 4% with immediate vesting 

- Flexible PTO (typically 3 to 4 weeks a year) 

- 10 paid holidays 

- Monthly contributions for life activities & wellness 

- Access to LinkedIn Learning with monthly dedicated time to explore 

- Connection, access, and mentorship from exceptional leaders 

- Growing company with opportunities for advancement 

- Authenticity and accountability from leadership 

Compensation Transparency 

The compensation range for this position is $170,000 – $190,000. 
The posted cash compensation includes on-target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. 

Equal Opportunity 

NetDocuments is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, (including pregnancy), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, military and veteran status, or any other status protected by laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. title: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform
description:
Headquarters: Phoenix, Arizona

URL: https://adventuretravel365.com/ 

Senior Full-Stack Developer - Marketplace Web & Mobile Platform

We have a big idea, and we’re looking for a top-notch Senior Full-Stack Developer to help us bring it to life.

We’re building a new contractor referral and services marketplace, think Thumbtack or Angi , where clients can easily find and connect with contractors and service providers. The vision includes both an interactive web platform and mobile app, with everything from user accounts and referrals to job tracking, payments, advertising, and more.

This is a fully remote, full-time, ongoing position, and we’re open to applicants worldwide. 

There are a lot of moving pieces, which is exactly why we’re looking for someone who has built something like this before and gets excited about taking a platform from an idea to a working product, then continuing to grow it with us.

What You’ll Help Us Build

The platform will have two main sides: clients looking for services and contractors/vendors looking for business. 

Some of the functionality we’re planning includes:

- Client and contractor/vendor accounts and profiles

- Contractor listings, categories, search, and filtering

- Service requests, inquiries, referrals, and lead management

- Job and project tracking

- Client and vendor dashboards

- Online payments and transaction tracking

- Reviews and ratings

- Notifications and communications

- Banner advertising and paid promotional opportunities

- Admin tools for managing the platform

- Reporting and analytics

- Secure management of user, job, and transaction data

And probably more! We have a strong vision for where we want this to go, but we also want the right developer to help us determine the smartest way to build it.

This will be an evolving platform, so we’re looking for someone who wants to grow with it, not simply complete a checklist of features. 

Who We’re Looking For

We’d love to find someone with strong experience in full-stack web and mobile development , especially someone who has worked on a marketplace, booking platform, service-provider network, or another multi-user platform.

You should be comfortable with:

- Full-stack web development

- Mobile or cross-platform app development

- Strong front-end and back-end development

- Multi-user marketplace platforms

- User authentication and account management

- Payment gateway integrations

- Databases and APIs

- Third-party integrations

- Dashboards and reporting

- Secure, scalable application architecture

- Cloud hosting and deployment

- Testing, maintenance, and optimization

- Using modern AI-powered development tools and integrating AI capabilities into web and mobile applications

If you’ve worked on something similar to Thumbtack, Angi, TaskRabbit, Upwork, or another two-sided marketplace , we definitely want to hear about it.

More Than Just Coding

We’re not looking for someone who simply waits for a list of instructions and starts coding.

We want someone who can look at the big picture, ask the right questions, recommend the best technical approach, flag potential challenges, and help turn our ideas into a platform that’s intuitive, scalable, and built to grow.

You’ll also be expected to study established platforms like Thumbtack and Angi , understand how their user journeys and marketplace functionality work from both the client and service-provider sides, and use those learnings to help us determine the best approach for our own platform.

You should be able to take the project through planning, architecture, development, testing, launch, and beyond , while communicating clearly with a non-technical team along the way.

Strong spoken and written English communication skills are important. You should be comfortable discussing ideas, explaining technical decisions clearly, and communicating regularly with a non-technical team.

This is not a short-term build-and-leave project. We’re looking for someone who can stay with the platform as it grows, helping us continually improve, expand, and maintain it over time.

Interested? Tell Us About Yourself

Please send us:

- A quick introduction

- Your resume or LinkedIn profile

- Your portfolio and links to websites/apps you’ve built

- Examples of marketplaces, booking platforms, referral systems, or payment-enabled platforms you’ve worked on

- What you personally worked on for those projects

- Your experience using AI in development

- What technologies/frameworks you’d recommend for a project like this and why

- Your availability

A short video introduction would be great, too! Nothing overly formal, just a quick introduction so we can get to know you, hear about your experience, and get a feel for how you communicate.

Most importantly, show us what you’ve built. If you’ve helped create a multi-sided marketplace similar to Thumbtack or Angi, tell us about it. We’d love to see it.

- 
Own production services and platform components end-to-end: monitoring, on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis, and iterative hardening.

4+ years of professional software engineering experience building backend systems, APIs, or platform products (seniority flexible based on impact and scope).

Strong experience with service-oriented backend development and one of the following languages (TypeScript, Go, C#) and willingness to learn other languages based on context.

Strong experience working with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling.

Experience shipping production-grade APIs and thinking deeply about developer experience and platform usability.

Strong testing mindset (unit, integration, end to end and contract testing) and hands-on CI/CD experience.

Familiarity with enterprise identity/security patterns (OAuth2/OIDC, API keys, token rotation, least privilege).

title: AI Tech Lead, Remote (based in Europe)
description:
Virtusan is a Swiss based health coaching platform for sleep, stress and recovery that works with any wearable, including our own smart ring. We're hiring our first AI Tech Lead to build the intelligence behind our coach: turning biometric and behavioural signals into personalised programmes that help people sleep better and stress less. You’ll be the technical authority for AI across engineering; you make the calls on architecture and approach, set the standards others build to and stay hand-on in the code.

What you'll be doing

1) Signal interpretation: Turn wearable and in-app data into recovery, stress and sleep insights, using personal baselines and trend detection.

2) Multi-device data: Normalise metrics across vendors, weight sources by reliability, and handle missing data and device switches.

3) Recommendation engine: Personalise protocol sequences by dose and timing with classical ML (e.g. contextual bandits, sequential recommenders or RL).

4) Feedback loops: Learn from real user behaviour and biometric responses which protocols work, and for whom.

5) Evaluation: Offline metrics, online experiments and production monitoring for every model and LLM feature.

6) AI platform: Own the roadmap, training and serving pipelines, data quality and architecture on our Python and Azure stack.

7) Technical leadership: Make and own the key architecture and modelling decisions, and write them down (RFCs, ADRs etc.) so the team can build them.

8) Privacy: Make secure handling of sensitive health data part of the design from the start.

9) Collaboration: Help product, design and marketing shape AI features and understand what the models can and can't do.

Hands on: This is a builder role. You’ll be prototyping, evaluating and taking code through to production.

Requirements

- 6+ years in ML/AI engineering incl. 2+ years in a lead role, with at least one product taken from zero to production

- Python, FastAPI and production MLOps on Azure or another major cloud

- Time series, recommender systems, causal/uplift methods and strong statistics

- A/B testing, model evaluation and production monitoring

- LLMs and LangGraph (or similar) on Azure OpenAI, and knowing when not to use them

- Experience as a tech lead or staff engineer, making technical decisions that a team of engineers followed.

- Privacy-aware handling of health data

- Based in Europe and fluent in English

- Nice to have: bandits, RL or off-policy evaluation; health or wearable data; literature mining; AI in engineering workflows (coding agents, AI-assisted testing, CI).

Application process

Instead of a cover letter, please send us the answers to 2 of the following 3 questions together with your CV.

1) Tell us about an ML product you took from zero to production. What did you own, and what changed because of it?

2) You have a recommendation engine and want to know whether a protocol actually improves users' sleep. How would you measure that?

3) Tell us about a technical decision you made for a team that others disagreed with. How did you get alignment, and how did it turn out?

title: Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
Who are we and why should you join us? 


BetterHelp is on a mission to champion the well-being in all of us. We’re working to make mental healthcare more accessible, so more people can get the support they need, when they need it. As the world’s largest online therapy service, we’ve connected millions of people with a network of more than 30,000 licensed therapists-- and we’re not stopping there. As the unmet need for mental health services continues to grow, BetterHelp is committed to being part of the solution.


As a Full Stack Software Engineer at BetterHelp, you’ll join a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, product pros, creatives, marketers, and business leaders who share a passion for expanding access to therapy. You’ll have the opportunity to make an immediate impact, grow alongside the business, and do meaningful work alongside people who care deeply about what we’re building together.


What are we looking for? 


We're looking for a talented software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, learning continuously, and building products that make a meaningful difference. This role is ideal for someone who has delivered multiple challenging projects, takes pride in writing thoughtful, maintainable code, and enjoys both mentoring and learning from teammates.


You'll join an engineering culture that values ownership, curiosity, collaboration, and sound technical judgment. We embrace modern engineering practices and thoughtfully adopt new technologies, including AI, to help engineers focus on solving hard problems while keeping human expertise at the center of every decision.


What technologies will you work with? 


We use a mix of established and modern technologies to support a platform serving millions of users. As our products evolve, we're continually improving our architecture, modernizing portions of our codebase, and evaluating technologies that help us build secure, reliable, and scalable software.



- Backend: Linux, nginx, Laravel (PHP), MySQL, Redis

- Frontend: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS/SASS

- Existing technologies you may encounter as we modernize the platform: Twig, Bootstrap, jQuery


We do not expect candidates to have worked with every technology in our environment. We value strong software engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.


What will you do? 



- You will develop end to end, owning features from technical design and development through deployment, monitoring, and continued improvement.

- You will write clean, secure, readable, maintainable, and scalable code.

- You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, designers, and other cross-functional partners.

- You will design, integrate, and build internal and external APIs.

- You will develop new products and features while improving and modernizing existing systems.

- You will write and optimize SQL queries and design relational database schemas.

- You will create and maintain complex backend services and algorithms.

- You will profile, troubleshoot, and optimize new and legacy code.

- You will build experiences that work across mobile, tablet, and desktop environments.

- You will contribute to code reviews, technical discussions, and engineering practices that improve quality, reliability, security, and developer experience.

- You will ship thoughtfully and frequently in an agile environment with continuous deployment.

- You will care about our product, mission, and long-term success, well beyond checking off development tasks.

- You will thoughtfully use approved AI-assisted development tools to reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, and improve productivity while applying your own engineering judgment to architecture, implementation, security, privacy, and code quality. Engineers remain accountable for every technical decision.


What will you NOT do? 



- You will NOT worry about funding. We have startup energy, with the support and resources of our parent company, Teladoc Health.

- You will NOT be limited to a narrow set of responsibilities. We encourage employees to contribute ideas, develop new skills, collaborate across teams, and explore opportunities that support both their growth and the growing needs of the business.

- You will NOT be expected to navigate a culture driven by ego or unnecessary hierarchy. We value respectful collaboration, thoughtful debate, and teammates who are committed to shared success.

- You will NOT be expected to sacrifice your well-being to make an impact. We work hard and hold ourselves to high standards, all while supporting sustainable ways of working.

- You will NOT have to wonder why your work matters. The work we do here helps to expand access to mental health care and supports people seeking help when they need it.


Can I work remotely? 


Yes. This role can be performed remotely from anywhere in the U.S. While we embrace the flexibility of remote work, we also value opportunities to bring teams together in person for collaboration and connection. BetterHelp covers approved expenses for company-requested travel, and reasonable accommodations are available for employees who are unable to travel.


Requirements 



- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

- Deep understanding of web development concepts and principles.

- Examples of full-stack projects or significant product features.

- At least one major demonstrable project that includes frontend code, backend code, and a database.

- Ability to design, develop, and launch a web application or substantial feature from start to finish.

- Ability to learn quickly, navigate an established codebase, and build new skills independently.

- A strong sense of ownership and eagerness to build something meaningful.

- Five or more years of professional web development experience in any stack, solving challenging problems and implementing new features from scratch.

- Three or more years of experience with SQL, including relational schema design and complex queries.

- Familiarity with web application, data, and SQL security best practices.

- Comfort working outside the abstractions of a framework and understanding what is happening behind the scenes.

- Experience using Git in a collaborative team environment.

- Sound engineering judgment and a thoughtful approach to modern development tools, including AI assistants, with appropriate attention to security, privacy, and code quality.


Bonus (Helpful, but not required) 



- Experience working with PHP, Laravel, or the LAMP/LEMP ecosystem.

- Experience with React or Next.js.

- Experience modernizing established applications or incrementally replacing legacy systems.

- Experience working in a startup, growth-stage company, or other fast-moving environment.

- Experience building products in health care, mental health, or another highly regulated or privacy-sensitive field.

- Experience mentoring or supporting the growth of other engineers.


Benefits 



- Remote work with regular in-person bonding experiences sponsored by the company

- Competitive compensation 

- Holistic perks program (including free therapy, employee wellness, and more)

- Excellent health, dental, and vision coverage

- 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

- The chance to build something that changes lives – and that people love 

- Any piece of hardware or software that will make you happy and productive

- An awesome community of co-workers


The base salary range for this position is $110,000 - $160,000. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and the extensive benefits listed here (subject to eligibility requirements): Teladoc Health Benefits 2026 . Total compensation is based on several factors – including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable to all full-time positions.


At BetterHelp we thrive on difference and individuality, and as part of the Teladoc Health family, we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We never have and never will discriminate against any job candidate or employee due to age, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, medical condition, marital status, parental status, disability, or Veteran status. 


Notice to Candidates: 
BetterHelp has been made aware of fraudulent job postings and unaffiliated third parties posing as our recruiting team – please know that we have no affiliation or connection to these situations. We only post open roles on our career page ( betterhelp.com/careers ) or reputable job boards like our official LinkedIn or Indeed pages, and all official BetterHelp recruitment emails will come from the domain @ betterhelp.com . Our commitment is to ensure a safe and transparent hiring experience for all candidates. We will never ask you for money, gift cards, or any form of payment during our hiring process, and we will never send money or checks to candidates. If you experience this, it is a scam.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
Headquarters: Australia 

URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/ 

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/askable-software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-contract

title: Finance Manager
description:
We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure. 

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage , and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox , and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026 .

About the role 

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing 

- Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

- Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

- Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

- Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

- Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

- Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

- Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

- Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them

- Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions , pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding

- Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t

- Managing our outsourced bookkeeping , accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster

- Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it , actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts

- Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount

- Acting as the financial conscience of the business , with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow

What we’re looking for 

- Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny

- Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish

- Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control

- Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US

- AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you

- Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does

- A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them

- Ideally, SaaS or subscription business experience, particularly ARR reporting and deferred revenue, and familiarity with modern billing infrastructure like Xero or Stripe

- Comfort with SQL, Python, or low-code automation tools is a bonus, not a requirement, but it will make your life here significantly easier

What to expect 

Being Financial Controller at Happl is not a maintenance role. You’ll be building the finance function as you run it — choosing the systems, designing the controls, and deciding how billing, revenue recognition, and reporting should work as we scale into new markets and currencies. That’s not a caveat; it’s the role.

Some weeks will be genuinely rewarding — a reporting pack you built gives the board real clarity, a manual process you automated saves the team hours every month, a treasury decision you made puts real value on the table. Some will be hard — closing the books on a fixed timetable, holding partners and advisors to a deadline, and making judgement calls across two jurisdictions with incomplete information.

What you get in return is real scope. You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors. This is the foundation of a finance function that will grow with the business, and the right person grows with it.

Why join Happl 

- Be part of building something that genuinely matters — the future of how companies support their people

- Competitive salary that reflects the impact you’ll have

- Real equity — a meaningful stake in what we’re building together

- Hybrid working from day one, with the trust and flexibility to do your best work

- Your own Happl account — use the platform you’re helping to build and shape

- Private Health Insurance, because we genuinely care about how you’re doing

- Dental insurance, including family cover

- A personal Wellbeing budget to spend however wellbeing works for you — no questions asked

- A dedicated L&D budget to grow in the direction that excites you

- Pension — we’re invested in your future, not just the short term

About the Interview 

- Stage 1: 20-min Intro call with Ben Shorrock (Head of Operations)

- Stage 2: Short task

- Stage 3: 30-min deep dive and task review with Ben T (CEO) & Ben S (Ops)

Additional Details 

- Location: London, Holborn

- Team: Finance

- Reports to: CEO

- Working arrangement: Hybrid (4+ Days in Office)

title: Senior Integrity Engineer
description:
Senior Integrity Engineer 

Europe | Remote (hybrid near an Intero office) | 32-40 hours

An inspection shows a client what is wrong. You show them what to do about it.

Are you the integrity engineer people turn to when the inspection data is in and a decision has to be made? Do you enjoy combining fracture mechanics, corrosion growth and sound engineering judgment into advice an operator can actually act on? Then we would like to meet you. We are growing our Integrity team and are looking for our first Senior Integrity Engineer based in Europe.

About Intero 

Intero Integrity Services helps pipeline operators and industrial companies keep their assets safe, compliant and running. With our own in-line inspection technology (including MFL and UT) we inspect pipelines and installations all over the world and tell clients exactly what condition their assets are in. Headquartered in Tricht, the Netherlands, we have over 40 years of experience and 650+ professionals from 25+ nationalities.
Learn more about our Inspection service line in this video: Intero - The Power of Integrity .

Your team 

You join a close-knit Integrity team of five, including you: a Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead in Vancouver, an Integrity Engineer in Mexico City and two Junior Integrity Engineers in Toronto and Calgary. The team is part of our Data Analysis (DA) department.

Together the team delivers integrity reports for clients around the globe. You will be in daily contact with your teammates. The atmosphere is informal, communication is clear and transparent, and the pace follows the workload: some weeks are calm, others are full on. As the first team member in Europe, you strengthen our coverage of European time zones and clients.

Why this role matters 

An inspection delivers a list of findings. For our clients, especially in highly regulated markets, a list of problems without a solution is not enough. That is where you come in. The Integrity team turns inspection results into a complete solution package: assessments, remaining life, and clear recommendations that help operators make well-founded decisions about the continued operation of their systems. In this role you raise the quality and consistency of that package, review the work of junior engineers, and help develop the tools and methods the team relies on.

What your week looks like 

Part of your week goes to performing integrity assessments on pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers. The other part goes to supporting business development, developing methods and giving technical support. From day one you will work on Corrosion Growth (CG) reports and Fitness-for-Service (FFS) assessments.

· Perform Level 1 and Level 2 FFS assessments and advanced Corrosion Growth Analysis (CGA); review or prepare Level 3 FFS assessments where projects require it.

· Review the work of junior engineers, such as Run Comparison reports, dent strain and bending strain analyses, against the applicable codes and standards.

· Act as the technical point of contact for project managers and clients on structural integrity questions, and support proposals and client-facing technical activities.

· Align recommendations with local and national regulations, and build knowledge of codes and standards across jurisdictions.

· Validate and help develop our in-house engineering tools, and write Python or VBA scripts to automate evaluations based on MFL and UT inspection data.

· Set up and maintain internal procedures, technical questionnaires and quality checklists so every deliverable meets client and internal standards.

· Manage several projects at the same time, and flag risks and priorities early.

What you bring

Must-haves 

· A degree in Mechanical and/or Materials (or Metallurgical) Engineering, ideally a combination of both. A Master's degree is a strong plus.

· At least 5 years of relevant experience in the structural integrity of pressurised equipment, preferably pipelines, including independently performing and reviewing FFS assessments and remaining life calculations.

· Strong working knowledge of fracture mechanics and corrosion and fatigue damage mechanisms.

· Working knowledge of API 579 / ASME FFS-1, API 530, ASME B31G, DNV-RP-F101, API 1183, ASME VIII Div. 2 and ASME PCC-2, and of the international regulations for pipeline and pressure equipment integrity.

· Experience with risk assessments and turning results into clear, actionable recommendations.

· Strong mathematics and statistics, including probabilistic methods.

· Programming skills to solve engineering problems, preferably in Python, VBA or MATLAB.

· Mid to advanced-level training in integrity assessment methods.

· You write clear, professional technical reports and explain complex topics to both technical and non-technical audiences.

· You work independently with minimal supervision, keep your agreements, and are flexible with working hours to collaborate with colleagues in Canada and Mexico.

· You are curious, proactive and a team player who suggests improvements to help the team work better and avoid rework.

Nice-to-haves 

· Hands-on experience with finite element analysis (FEA), preferably ABAQUS.

· Experience with creep assessment of boilers and heaters.

· Exposure to Level 3 FFS assessments.

· Experience with pipeline ILI data analysis (MFL/UT).

· Experience with client-facing technical activities or proposals.

· Experience in highly regulated industries.

Why Intero 

· Work that makes a difference. Your recommendations directly determine whether critical pipelines and installations can keep operating safely.

· Variety. Pipelines, piping, heaters and boilers; FFS Level 1 to 3, corrosion growth, dent strain and more, for clients all over the world.

· Real influence. You help shape the team's methods, procedures and in-house tools, and see your ideas put into practice.

· International team, flexible set-up. Daily collaboration with colleagues in Canada and Mexico, remote working from Europe, and once or twice a year a visit to our HQ in Tricht.

· Growth. Within one to three years you can take on a larger share of Run Comparison and FFS reviews and expand into dent strain analysis. 

What we offer 

· A contract for 32-40 hours per week.

· A competitive salary and benefits package, tailored to the country you're based in. Because pay and conditions vary by location, we'll discuss the details with you personally during the process.

· Remote working from Europe, or hybrid if you live near one of our offices with available space.

· Flexible start of the day between 6:00 and 10:00, with occasional early or late meetings to overlap with our North American team.

Application process 

1. Introductory interview with our recruiter.
2. Technical interview with our Principal Integrity Engineer and Team Lead.
3. Final interview with Manager and Business Director.
4. Job offer.

description:

✨ Our values 

Our values guide our approach to work and are at the heart of our recruitment process. To join our team, we look for individuals who value: 

- Excellence: We think that every detail counts, and we place great importance on the quality of our deliverables. 

- Trust: We are passionate, committed, and free to act with autonomy.

🤝 The team 

You will join our Global MidMarket Customer Success team, a group of Customer Success Managers who each own a broad, evolving portfolio of mid-market accounts. While the function operates globally, this specific opening is dedicated to the EMEA & APAC regions 

Based in Paris, you will work closely with 2 Mid-Market CSMs (1 in London, 1 in NYC) and 1 Scale Ops Manager (Paris). Matthieu , Head of Scale CSM and your manager, based in Paris, will support you in achieving your goals. You will also be part of a global Customer Success community across our international offices. 

Here is what the Go-To-Market organization looks like at UpSlide: 

- Account Executives: Prospect, acquire new business acquisition and expand existing accounts 

- Consultants: Lead implementation projects, deliver client training, and ensure successful deployment 

- Customer Success Managers: Own a portfolio of accounts end-to-end, driving retention, renewal signing, expansion within existing entities, value realization, and long-term account growth. Split between Enterprise CSMs , who build deep, tailored relationships with a small number of strategic accounts, and Mid-Market CSMs , who manage a larger book of accounts with a focus on speed and ROI, acting where and when it counts 

- Support Engineers : Resolve day-to-day technical questions and issues, and ensure a smooth customer experience 

🖋️ Your responsibilities 

As a Mid-Market Customer Success Manager, you will own a broad portfolio of Mid-Market accounts end-to-end. Working at pace and using usage data and account signals to prioritize your day, you will make sure your accounts renew, stay healthy, and grow, spotting upsell/expand opportunities as proactively as you spot churn risk, and owning both through to close. 

This is a role for someone energized by volume and by building repeatable, data-driven ways of working across a large book of business, without losing the client-first mindset that drives portfolio growth. 

Portfolio Ownership & Signal-Driven Execution (60%) 

Own the business performance and KPIs of a large portfolio of Mid-Market accounts, and take individual accountability for contributing to team and company targets: 

- Own your portfolio's KPIs (usage, renewal rate, NRR, churn) end to end with a hunter/rescuer mindset: moving fast to capture opportunity, and stepping in decisively when an account is at risk 

- Structure your coverage around two core touchpoints, kickoff and renewal, complemented by additional touchpoints where and when the data calls for it 

- Continuously monitor usage data, health scores, and other signals to prioritize your day and catch risk or opportunity early 

- React quickly and decisively on negative signals to protect the account, and on positive signals to capture upsell potential 

- Judge, account by account, how much time and effort a situation deserves, and adjust your touchpoint cadence accordingly - guided increasingly by shared scoring and playbooks as the Scale motion matures 

Product & Industry Expertise (20%) 

Build broad product and industry expertise to support adoption at scale, rather than deep knowledge of any single client: 

- Develop a strong understanding of UpSlide's product and of the industries your portfolio operates in 

- Contribute to adoption initiatives such as webinars and open office hours, sharing your expertise across the client base 

Scale Motion Optimization (10%) 

Bring a critical eye to how the Mid-Market motion runs, and help make it faster and more effective: 

- Share structured feedback on where automation and process changes can save time 

- Suggest and help build content that increases client engagement and adoption 

- Work closely with the Scale Ops Manager and the Head of Scale to turn feedback into concrete improvements 

Cross-functional Collaboration (10%) 

Stay connected to the teams around your portfolio, notably those handling first-line requests: 

- Sync regularly with Support and Sales Admin, who own level 1 requests and escalate to you when needed 

- Partner with Sales on expansion opportunities that require broader support 

To work on these tasks, you will mainly use the following tools: Microsoft Office, UpSlide, Salesforce, Gong, PowerBI, Notion (or local equivalents). 

⚡ Your goals 

What you'll be assessed on: 

- Net Revenue Retention (NRR) 

- Churn 

- Upsell / Expansion contribution 

- CRM data quality and forecast accuracy 

You are a great fit if you have: 

- 2/3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a related client-facing/revenue role in a B2B environment 

- Proven experience managing renewals and churn across a portfolio of accounts, with the confidence to handle difficult conversations (renegotiation, dissatisfaction) as needed 

- Proven ability to identify and close expansion/upsell opportunities, with a hunter mindset and a strong ROI orientation 

- Experience autonomously managing a sizeable portfolio, ideally including Mid-Market accounts 

- A structured, analytical approach to account planning at volume , using data to prioritize a broad book of business and anticipate risk 

- Operational rigor: accurate CRM data, reliable follow-up, dependable forecasting 

- Excellent written and verbal communication in French and English 

- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, international environment 

We’d love it if you have: 

- Experience with analytics / BI tools (PowerBI or equivalent) 

- Advanced negotiation skills 

- Knowledge of the financial services / professional services sector 

- Familiarity with SaaS metrics (ARR, NRR, churn, forecasting) and reporting to leadership 

✨ If you don’t tick all the boxes but you think you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why. 

Recruitment process 

- Screening call with a Talent Acquisition Specialist: A conversation to walk through your experience, motivation, and fit for the role. 

- Interview with your future manager or their peer: A deeper dive into your Customer Success experience and approach to account management. 

- Case study + team-meet: A live exercise reflecting real challenges of the role, followed by a conversation with members of the wider team. 

- Final conversation with leadership: A closing discussion to align on ambition, expectations, and next steps. 

🚀 We'll conduct a reference check to learn how to help you thrive. On average, our process lasts 3 weeks.

What we offer 

🌍 International environment: Start-up with five offices (Paris, London, Berlin, New York, Singapore) and users in more than 60 countries 

🌱 Training & professional development: Collaboration with our sister company, IPH , which provides UpSliders with training on key soft skills and management 

🎉 Company events: Office socials and international company events (e.g. annual company seminar, team seminar, and sustainability actions taken throughout the year) 

🏠 Beautiful office: Office near Opéra (1er arrondissement) – a vibrant space with beautiful common areas and meeting rooms, a nap room, bike storage and showers, tea/coffee, etc. 

💻 Hybrid work: A policy adapted to each team’s rhythm 

🧑‍💻 Work-from-home budget: €500 WFH equipment budget 

💆‍♀️ Wellness package: 50€ per month for physical and mental wellness activities 

👶 Family support:
