title: Summer Intern 2027
description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

- One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

- Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

- Profitable since 2017 

- Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs 

- Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot )

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. 

Join us if you want to

- Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

- Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

- Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role 

This is a 10 week internship program starting from 29th June 2027 

Salary - £50,000 (per annum) 

We’re looking for a super smart student who is great with numbers and loves problem solving to come and apply your skills in a start up environment a nd have a big impact on our business and how we do things.

What you'll be doing 

- Use your analytical and problem-solving skills to generate key insights from data, and use that insight to drive meaningful change in our strategy

- Using data and modelling to ground assumptions for our NPV model, such as predicting what default rates will be in the future, and using that to inform our lending deicsions

- Using data and analytics to drive decisions about who we should lend to, and how much we should lend to them, and how that changes with the economy and competition changes

- Conducting hypothesis testing, and using your findings to change how we do things in areas such as lending strategy, pricing, and fraud detection

- Presenting your findings to senior leaders in the company, then work with the product/tech team to get them implemented

What we're looking for 

- A university student in their penultimate year (can be undergraduates, masters or PhD students)

- Must have coding skills in Python or SQL 

- Someone that loves numbers ! You’ll be working with numbers every single day in this role so you’ll be able to demonstrate your ability to work with complex data sets, analyse them and draw insights

- You’ll have a natural curiosity and love to dig into things to understand how they work 

- Startup mindset . We’re a fast-growth tech startup so you’ll be super excited to work in an entrepreneurial environment and have a real impact on the business

Interview Process 

- 15-minute online test

- Coding Take Home Task

- Remote (video call) Task Debrief (60 mins)

- Remote (video call) case study (60 mins)

- In-person case study (60 min) + Culture Add Conversation (15 minutes) + a chance to meet other recent grads over lunch (30-45 minutes)

Life at Lendable

- Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

- Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

- Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

- Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

- Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

- Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

- Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

- Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner. 

Check out our blog !

description:
About Motorway 

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

👋 Hi, I’m Manuele Maggi, Engineering Manager at Motorway. I’m looking for an Android

Engineer to join our Mobile Engineering group and help us build a best-in-class experience

for our Sellers.

This is a great opportunity to join a talented and supportive team, working alongside

engineers, product managers and designers to fundamentally change the way people sell

their car. You’ll contribute to meaningful features used by customers across the UK, develop

your technical skills and explore the latest tools and technologies—with AI increasingly

embedded in how we build and work.

About the role 

As an Android Engineer, you’ll take ownership of well-defined features and contribute

throughout the development lifecycle, from early ideas through to release and iteration.

Day-to-day, you’ll be:

- Collaborating with designers, product managers and other engineers to build high-quality customer experiences.

- Designing, building and shipping Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.

- Contributing to the development of our in-house Server-Driven UI framework, helping us deliver features and dynamic experiences more quickly.

- Supporting and improving our mobile infrastructure, including CI/CD pipelines with

- GitHub Actions, Google Play deployment workflows and automated UI testing.

- Writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

- Participating in code reviews and technical discussions, learning from others while sharing your own ideas.

- Paying close attention to UI detail, accessibility and the overall app experience.

- Building an understanding of the backend systems and APIs that power our app.

- Monitoring released features and helping to resolve issues when they arise.

- Contributing to the engineering standards and practices used across the Mobile Engineering group.

About you 

- We’re looking for someone with:

- Commercial experience building Android applications.

- Good knowledge of Kotlin and modern Android development.

- Experience with Jetpack Compose, or an interest in developing your skills with it.

- An understanding of common mobile development principles, patterns and testing practices.

- Experience building and releasing features as part of a collaborative product team.

- The ability to write clear, maintainable and well-tested code.

- Good collaboration and communication skills.

- A proactive approach and willingness to take ownership of your work.

- Curiosity and a genuine desire to continue learning and developing as an engineer.

You could be a great fit if 

- You’ve contributed to reusable components or modules.

- You enjoy working closely with product and design to solve customer problems.

- You’re comfortable owning features while asking for support when needed.

- You care about building polished, reliable and accessible mobile experiences.

- You’re interested in using modern technologies, including AI, to improve products and engineering workflows.

- You enjoy sharing ideas, receiving feedback and learning from experienced engineers.

Bonus 

- You don’t need to tick every box, but it would be helpful if:

- You have experience with Server-Driven UI.

- You have worked with A/B testing or experimentation.

- You have some exposure to CI/CD and automated mobile testing.

- You have integrated ML or AI-powered functionality into an app.

- You have experience or an interest in backend or full-stack development.

- You have experience taking a feature from an initial idea through to release.

Location 

Hybrid working, with two days a week in our London office and the remainder working from

home.

Our interview process 

- Qualifying Screen — 30 minutes

- Technical Interview — 60 minutes

- Soft Skills Interview — 60 minutes, onsite depending on the team

You can expect to hear back from us within a week of each interview stage. You’ll also have

the opportunity to speak with a Talent Partner throughout the process if you have any

questions or require any accommodations.

Benefits 

- We’ve got your back in life’s biggest moments—and the everyday ones too.

- Competitive salary

- Equity scheme—we all share in Motorway’s success

- 25 days’ holiday

- Flexible working, including two days a week in our London office, with socials and snacks galore

- Private medical insurance through Bupa

- Life assurance

- Pension scheme with a 5% employer contribution

- Enhanced family leave, including 26 weeks’ full pay for maternity or adoption leave

- 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

- EV leasing scheme

- Cycle to Work scheme

- Nursery salary-sacrifice scheme

- One paid volunteering day each year

title: Test Engineer
description:
Join our cutting-edge start-up adventure! 

Who are we? 

Join the Revolution in GNSS and IoT Connectivity 

At Qualinx , we’re not just building chips, we’re engineering the future fabric of the connected world. As a pioneering semiconductor scale-up, we’re transforming how devices connect, communicate, and operate through our ground-breaking Digital RF technology. Our mission goes beyond ultra-low power GNSS: we’re redefining what’s possible in adaptive, scalable, and intelligent connectivity for the Internet of Things.

Born from deep-tech innovation at TU Delft, our team of visionary engineers and bold thinkers is tackling the toughest challenges in GNSS and IoT, starting with power consumption and expanding into dynamic, context-aware solutions that adapt to any environment or use case. We’ve already achieved what many thought impossible: the world’s most advanced GNSS chipset. But that’s just the beginning.

At Qualinx, we believe that the future of connectivity lies in precision, efficiency, and adaptability. Our ambition is to become the invisible thread that seamlessly interconnects billions of devices: powering a smarter, more responsive world.

What Sets Us Apart 

Joining Qualinx is about becoming part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. We hold ourselves to high standards, thrive on solving the unexpected, and push boundaries together. But we also know how to enjoy the ride. Our culture is a unique blend of curiosity, team spirit, and a touch of unconventional charm. It’s fast-paced, fun, and grounded in a sober sense of purpose and perspective. Whether we’re deep in design reviews or sharing laughs over lunch, we’re building something meaningful together. At Qualinx, you’re not just contributing to a ground-breaking technology, you’re helping shape a team that’s redefining what it means to work in deep tech.

Job Description 

As a Test Engineer, you will support the development and production release of test solutions for Qualinx products. Working closely with Design, Product Engineering, Reliability, and external manufacturing partners, you will contribute to digital and memory test development activities, product characterization, yield improvement, and production support.

Key Responsibilities 

- Support the development, validation, and release of production test solutions for Qualinx products.

- Support in developing and debugging ATE test programs for wafer sort and final test.

- Support silicon characterization, correlation, and production qualification activities.

- Analyze test results and production data to identify issues and opportunities for yield improvement.

- Work with Design and Product Engineering teams to investigate test failures and support root cause analysis.

- Contribute to test time optimization and test coverage improvements.

- Support OSAT and manufacturing partners during product bring-up and production ramp.

- Assist in implementing and validating digital test methodologies, including SCAN, MBIST, JTAG, and Flash testing.

- Develop automation scripts and tools to improve test efficiency and data analysis.

- Maintain test documentation and support continuous improvement of test processes.

Requirements 

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related field.

- Minimum five years of experience in semiconductor test engineering, product engineering, or a related role.

- Semiconductor test development and production test flow experience.

- Experience with semiconductor testing at wafer sort and/or package level.

- Experience with embedded digital interfaces such as SPI, I2C, UART, SWD, and JTAG.

- Understanding of digital test methodologies, including SCAN, MBIST, JTAG/Boundary Scan, IDDQ and Flash Memory Testing

- Experience with ATE platforms or test development environments such as NI and Teradyne IG-XL.

- Programming or scripting experience in Python, C/C++, MATLAB, or similar languages.

- Understanding of electronics fundamentals and digital circuit operation.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a diverse cross-functional team.

- Experience with NI PXIe, Teradyne J750HD, or UltraFLEX platforms.

Preferred Experience 

- Familiarity with data analysis tools (e.g MATLAB, JMP, or equivalent).

- Experience with ATPG and vector conversion flows using tools for production ATE implementation.

- Knowledge of Design-for-Test (DFT) concepts, including Scan, MBIST, JTAG, Boundary Scan, and ATPG.

- Experience working with OSATs in NPI and high-volume manufacturing environments.

- Exposure to WLCSP products, wafer sort, and wafer-level development and testing methodologies.

- Experience with test data analysis and yield monitoring tools is preferred.

What's in it for you? 

At Qualinx, we believe that great work starts with a great environment, pioneering technology and a fun dynamic market to address. Here’s what you can expect when you join our team:

- Ownership and Impact : We offer employee equity, giving you the opportunity to share in the success you help create.

- Well-being Matters : Your physical and mental health are important to us. We provide access to wellness resources, including company discounts and a free mental healthcare platform.

- Global Talent, Local Support : If you're relocating from abroad, we provide full support throughout the visa process to ensure a smooth transition.

- Future-Focused Benefits : We contribute to your pension savings to help you plan ahead with confidence.

- Inspiring Workspace : Work from a modern and vibrant, well-equipped office designed to help you do your best work.

- Scale-up Team Spirit : We celebrate our wins together with fun quarterly events—think great food, games, and unforgettable experiences.

title: Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d)
description:
Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. Es positioniert sich als Innovationsführer im Bereich industrieller Bedienoberflächen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

- Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
- Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
- Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)
- Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau
- Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung
- Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform
Deine Aufgaben

- Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
- Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
- Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
- Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
- Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
- Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
- Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
- Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen
Dein Profil

- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
- Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
- Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
- Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
- Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
- Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)
Was hier nicht funktioniert

- Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
- Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
- Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
- Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
- Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln
Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

- Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
- Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
- Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz
Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

title: Software Engineering Internship 2027
description:
Cambridge, UK | Full-time | Fixed-term, 10–12 weeks | Hybrid

Salary: £30,000–£35,000 per annum, depending on experience, paid pro rata for the internship duration.

About us 

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved. Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion. 

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.  

About the role 

Our full-time summer internships give current students in technical fields the opportunity to apply their skills and expertise in an industrial setting. 

You will join us at our head office in Cambridge, UK, for 10 to 12 weeks, working alongside talented software and hardware engineers, mathematicians, quantum information theorists and physicists who are experts in their fields. 

You will have a dedicated supervisor and work on a project designed to make the best use of your existing skills while developing your knowledge of quantum computing and quantum error correction. We will support you in producing a meaningful piece of work that you can be proud of by the end of your internship. 

Previous interns have committed code to industry-standard open-source compilers, co-authored research papers and led the design of new software tools. 

What you will do 

- 
Design, develop and test software that contributes to Riverlane’s quantum error correction technology.

- Work closely with colleagues across software engineering, research and other technical disciplines 

- Explore ideas, evaluate different approaches and contribute to technical problem-solving 

- Communicate your work clearly through discussions, presentations and written reports 

- Develop your understanding of quantum computers, quantum error correction and their potential applications 

What we need 

- 
You must be a current student at the time of application, studying towards a Bachelor’s degree (second year or later), Master’s degree or PhD.

- 
You must be studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Electronic Engineering or another related technical subject.

- 
Experience using at least one general-purpose programming language, demonstrated through coursework, personal projects or research.

- 
An understanding of core programming concepts, including data structures and algorithms.

- 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- 
Clear written and verbal communication skills.

- 
The ability to take initiative and work effectively as part of a team.

- 
An interest in applying your software skills to quantum computing; prior quantum computing knowledge or experience is not required.

- 
Availability to work full-time for 10–12 weeks.

Even better if… 

- 
You have experience with C++ or Python, the main languages you will use during the internship.

- 
You have experience writing tests, debugging code or using version control tools such as Git.

- 
You have developed software as part of a collaborative project.

Important notes 

- 
You must already have the right to work in the UK for the full duration of the internship. If you hold a UK student visa, please check that its conditions allow you to undertake this full-time internship.

- PhD students may need to temporarily step away from their PhD to complete the internship. This may affect their right-to-work status, and applicants should check their individual circumstances 

- You must be available to work full-time for 10 to 12 weeks during the summer vacation period 

- You will be required to sign an agreement assigning ownership of any intellectual property produced during your internship to Riverlane 

- Internships are based at our head office in Cambridge, UK 

How to apply 

Please upload a CV and covering letter through our careers page. Your CV should include the grades you have received so far in your degree(s). Your covering letter should explain why you are applying for the software engineering internship and what skills and experience you would bring.

Deadline 

Please submit your application by Friday 6 November 2026 . Interviews will be held in Cambridge, or virtually if required.

What can you expect from us 

Alongside a competitive salary, we offer private medical insurance, a health cash plan and life assurance, as well many other benefits. 

You can also expect a diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields (including software and hardware development, quantum information theory, physics and maths) and over 25 different nationalities. 

If you have any queries, please contact com . Please do not send your applications to this email address, all applications should be submitted via our careers page. 

Everyone is welcome at Riverlane. We are an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from eligible and suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender reassignment, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, or pregnancy and maternity/paternity. 

Women and other underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for a role unless they meet all or nearly all of the requirements. If this applies to you, we still encourage you to apply - you may be a great fit, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. We’d love to hear from you. 

If you need any adjustments made to the application or selection process so you can do your best, please let us know. We will be happy to help. 

GDPR notice: Riverlane collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. If you are a European Job Applicant see the privacy notice for further details.

title: Head of SEO & AI Search (H/F)
description:
À propos de Scento

Scento est le plus grand site de décants de parfum d'Europe. Fondée en 2024, l'entreprise a son siège à Paris, place Vendôme, et un second bureau à Berlin. Scento propose en décant plus de 1 000 parfums de créateurs et de niche, tous originaux, issus d'un portefeuille de 200 maisons : flacons de 2 ml, 5 ml et 8 ml, ainsi qu'un flacon de 30 ml pour la plupart des parfums. Le parfum décant permet de découvrir des échantillons de parfum de niche et de grandes maisons avant d'investir dans un flacon entier. Chaque parfum est un original acheté auprès de revendeurs européens agréés, et chaque flacon passe un contrôle d'entrée en 12 points sur le site certifié ISO de Scento avant d'être décanté.

Scento sert des clients dans 27 marchés européens et livre dans 26 pays de l'Union européenne. En 2026, le chiffre d'affaires annuel de Scento dépasse 30 millions d'euros, ventes en ligne et hors ligne confondues. Sur Scento.com, les ventes mensuelles de décants de septembre 2026 représentaient 3,2 fois celles de janvier 2026. Selon Scento, plus de 3 millions de décants de parfum sont vendus chaque année, soit environ un toutes les 10 secondes. En novembre 2025, Scento a annoncé un investissement de 25 millions d'euros sur trois ans dans la découverte du parfum en Europe.

Le poste

Quand un client cherche un parfum décant ou des échantillons de parfum de niche, Scento doit être la réponse, sur Google comme dans ChatGPT search, Perplexity, les AI Overviews de Google et Copilot. Notre catalogue réunit plus de 1 000 parfums originaux issus d'un portefeuille de 200 maisons, sur une boutique Next.js disponible en plusieurs langues.

En tant que Head of SEO & AI Search, vous pilotez la recherche organique de scento.com. Le succès, c'est un trafic organique qui croît marché après marché, des sources citées par les moteurs de réponse, et un impact mesurable sur le chiffre d'affaires.

Vos missions

- Vous pilotez le SEO technique, le contenu, le maillage interne et les données structurées de scento.com dans chaque langue de la boutique.
- Vous faites de Scento la source que les moteurs de recherche IA citent pour les échantillons de parfums de créateurs et les décants de niche.
- Vous dirigez le programme éditorial : guides de parfums, guides de maisons, études de données et journal, avec rédacteurs et traducteurs.
- Vous travaillez avec l'ingénierie sur les Core Web Vitals, le rendu, les sitemaps, l'hreflang et l'indexation d'une boutique Next.js.
- Vous développez l'autorité du site grâce aux relations presse digitales, aux récits fondés sur la donnée et aux liens de qualité.
- Vous mesurez tout dans la Search Console, l'analytics et le suivi de visibilité IA, et vous rendez compte de l'impact sur le chiffre d'affaires.
Votre profil

- Plus de 8 ans d'expérience en SEO, dont au moins 3 ans à la tête du SEO d'un site e-commerce multilingue en Europe.
- Une expertise technique approfondie : rendu JavaScript, données structurées, SEO international, budget de crawl.
- Une expérience concrète de la visibilité dans la recherche IA et de la façon dont les moteurs de réponse choisissent leurs sources.
- Une vraie aisance avec les données (Search Console, SQL ou tableurs, Ahrefs ou équivalent), un anglais courant ; le français ou l'allemand est un plus.
Ce que nous proposons

- Une rémunération située dans le haut du marché, complétée par une prime annuelle sur performance.
- Du télétravail possible partout dans l'UE, avec des bureaux à Paris (place Vendôme) et à Berlin.
- Une généreuse allocation mensuelle de parfums pour explorer l'ensemble du catalogue.
- Un budget de formation personnel de 2 500 € par an (cours, conférences, livres).
- 30 jours de congés payés par an, jours fériés en plus.
- Le matériel de votre choix et un budget d'aménagement de votre espace de travail.
- Une vraie autonomie et des décisions rapides, dans une entreprise qui se développe vite à travers l'Europe.
Rémunération et candidature

Rémunération : de 125 000 € à 160 000 € brut par an, en CDI à temps plein, plus une prime annuelle sur performance.

Lieu : Paris ou Berlin, ou en télétravail depuis toute l'Union européenne.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
ABOUT BEAMERY 

With the rapid expansion of AI and automation, the future of work has never been more challenging for organizations. Beamery’s unique jobs, skills and tasks data platform helps organizations navigate these challenges and make more informed decisions across Talent Lifecycle Management. Our solutions power recruitment, mobility, upskilling, diversity, work architecture and workforce planning for some of the world’s most forward-thinking companies.

We believe that where you work is much more than just a job. Millions of people are being left behind every day in their careers, and we’re on a mission to fix this by creating equal access to meaningful work, skills and careers for all.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a representative Beamery, creating an equitable, inclusive and engaging environment for our people.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us and help us transform the future of work once and for all.

What’s ahead — and why it’s an exciting time to join the team: 

Building agentic AI with advanced orchestration (multi-agent workflows, tool use, evaluation loops) that turns complex talent data into decisions.

- Training and fine-tuning our own models on unique data about jobs, skills and tasks, and benchmarking them against the best in our market.

- Joining an award-winning AI team (ACM RecSys Challenge 2026) that turns new ideas into innovative solutions with scientific rigour.

- Sharing our work and learning from industry peers through challenges, conferences and publications.

But it’s not all about creating high-quality products, we also very much value the company culture we have worked hard to create; built on trust, empathy & honesty ensuring our workforce is able to bring their full selves to work.

About the Team

The Data Science team builds the AI models behind Beamery's Data Foundry, the common data and AI layer powering all Beamery products, and works hand in hand with the product teams to empower their features with AI (such as Talent Match and recommendations). At the heart of our work is the Beamery taxonomy, the language of work (skills, role titles and tasks) that every Beamery product speaks, built on more than a decade of research and kept current by the Taxonomist, our agentic system, so it reflects the real pulse of the job market. We combine LLMs, Transformers and embedding models with classic machine learning, always choosing the best balance between quality, latency and cost.

We see ourselves as pioneers in AI for HR Tech: in 2026 the team finished 1st in the industry track and 2nd overall out of 40 teams at the ACM RecSys Challenge.

About the Role

You will join the team as a Senior Data Scientist and own our matching, recommendation and taxonomy mapping models, working closely with the product engineering teams that bring them to our customers. You will be responsible for the full cycle of your work, from defining how quality is measured and designing the models to running robust scientific experiments, tracking technical and business metrics, and writing and reviewing code. You will also advise the product teams on how to implement AI features with an evaluation-first mindset, and keep pushing the boundaries of Beamery's AI.

Key Responsibilities

- Build, improve and own our matching and recommendation models (e.g. candidate to job matching, internal mobility recommendations etc.).

- Apply an evaluation-first mindset: build golden datasets from real recruiter and user decisions, define quality metrics, design and run robust scientific experiments, track and report both technical and business metrics (using LLM-as-a-judge and human feedback), and communicate results and metrics clearly to the product teams.

- Write clean and tested Python code using AI coding agents (such as Claude Code or Codex), and review code with care, both from your peers and from AI agents, so the team's codebase stays consistent, readable and safe.

- Follow recent research (e.g. LLMs, embeddings, recommender systems, explainability, model evaluation) and bring the most relevant ideas into our product roadmap.

- Document your work and present it clearly to product, engineering and business stakeholders, and contribute to the team's research visibility (such as challenges, conferences and publications).

Required Skills and Experience

- A minimum of 2-4 years of experience as a Data Scientist, Senior Data Scientist (or a similar role) in an AI startup or an AI team, with a dynamic environment and a variety of use cases.

- Strong experience with recommender systems, search, ranking or matching (e.g. learning-to-rank, scoring models, Gradient Boosting Trees, embedding models).

- Fluency in evaluation: designing datasets and quality metrics (such as AUC, NDCG, precision and recall), and using LLM-as-a-judge and human feedback.

- A strong foundation in NLP and GenAI, including Transformers, LLMs and embedding models (training or fine-tuning them is a strong plus).

- High-quality software development skills in Python (clean design, testing, packaging, maintainable code etc.), practical knowledge of CI/CD, and hands-on experience with agentic coding, with the judgement to know when AI-generated code is right or wrong.

- The ability to simplify complex problems, to work with ambiguity, and to collaborate with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business stakeholders.

- A Master's degree or PhD, or equivalent experience, in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics or a related field.

Nice to Have

- Experience with explainable or conversational recommendations.

- Experience in HR Tech, talent acquisition or workforce data.

- Publications, open-source contributions or strong results in ML challenges (e.g. RecSys, Kaggle).

What We Offer

- The chance to own core AI models that are used by some of the world's most forward-thinking organisations.

- A team that publishes, competes and is recognised in the research community, while shipping real products.

- Work with the latest AI technologies and tools, including AI coding agents as part of the daily workflow.

- Close collaboration with experienced data scientists, QA, platform and product engineers.

title: Quality Systems Lead
description:
About us 

Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production.

Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator.

The role 

We're hiring a Quality Systems Lead to own how Encord measures the quality of the human data we deliver to frontier AI labs, physical AI companies and enterprise AI teams — the standard itself, the systems that evaluate against it, and the audit function that produces the ground truth behind both. Data quality is what our customers buy. As we scale across data types — image and video, document, medical, LLM evaluation, robot teleoperation, egocentric capture — quality coverage cannot scale linearly with headcount. So this role has two halves that make each other work. You will build automated evaluation: model-assisted and LLM-based screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output. And you will build and run a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists in India, whose judgements become the labelled ground truth that trains and calibrates that automated layer. As coverage automates, the audit team moves up to the cases models can't judge and to generating gold sets for each new data type we take on. It is an unusual combination — engineering and consistent QC operations in one person — and it is the combination the job needs. You will also have an advantage your counterparts elsewhere in the industry don't: Encord owns the platform this work runs on, so the measurement you build can become native capability in the product rather than internal tooling.

What you'll do 

- Build automated dataset quality evaluation and root-cause detection — model-assisted and LLM-as-judge screening, agreement analysis at scale, anomaly and drift detection across annotation output

- Hire, train, calibrate and manage a dedicated audit team of around ten specialists based in our India operation, held to inter-rater agreement and catch rate rather than volume audited

- Turn audit output into labelled ground truth that trains and validates the automated layer, and manage the ratio of automated to manual coverage deliberately over time

- Own the quality standard for every data type we deliver — written rubrics with worked edge cases, golden sets, and acceptance criteria agreed with the customer, alongside the Special Projects lead, before the first batch ships

- Build scoring systems that rank annotator and reviewer performance and feed routing, staffing and offboarding decisions

- Set the pass thresholds that certification gates on, so nobody works a project queue without having demonstrated they meet the standard

- Report quality KPIs to leadership, and into the reporting our Special Projects leads take to customers: accuracy against client spec, inter-annotator agreement, rework rate, cost of rework, and coverage

- Work with Project Management on remediation — you produce the measurement and the diagnosis, production owns fixing the project, and the standard stays independent of the people being measured

- Own the unit economics of quality: cost per audited unit, and the coverage you buy per pound spent

- Partner with Product and Engineering to bring quality measurement into Encord platform as native capability

Who we're looking for 

- You build and you operate. You'll write the evaluation pipeline, and you'll also run the weekly calibration session with ten auditors in another country

- Your instinct on a coverage problem is to automate it — you reach for a model, a heuristic or a better sampling design before you reach for more auditors

- Statistically literate in a practical way: sampling design, agreement statistics, and the judgement to spot a metric being optimised against rather than met

- You can hold a calibrated standard across a distributed team you don't sit with — you know that ten uncalibrated auditors produce ten standards

- A strong writer. Much of this job is producing rubrics a distributed workforce can follow without you in the room

- You hold a standard under commercial pressure, and you bring the evidence that makes it stick with a delivery team or a client

- Systems thinker: as interested in why a failure recurs across projects as in this project's defect rate

Experience requirements 

- 4+ years owning both technical and operational outcomes in a data, AI or service delivery environment where quality was measured rather than asserted

- Hands-on Python and SQL. You build the analysis and the tooling rather than specify it for someone else

- Practical experience applying models to a quality or evaluation problem — LLM-as-judge, model-assisted QA, automated evaluation, anomaly detection or classifier-based screening

- Sampling methodology and agreement statistics (Cohen's and Fleiss' kappa, F1 against ground truth) applied to real production data

- Experience hiring, training and managing a team, ideally an audit, review or QA team, and ideally distributed

- Track record of building a quality framework or function, including the reporting leadership and customers run on

- Bonus: direct experience of annotation, evaluation or model-training workflows, and of what frontier AI labs accept as evidence of quality

- Bonus: a STEM degree, or a background in data science or research engineering

- Bonus: multilingual delivery and linguistic quality assessment

Why Encord 

- Competitive salary, commission, and equity in a high-growth startup

- Strong in-person culture — most of the team works from our London office 4+ days/week

- 25 days annual leave + UK public holidays

- Annual learning & development budget

- Travel for customer visits, events, and conferences across the UK and Europe

- Company lunches twice a week

- Monthly socials & bi-annual team offsites

title: Lead Photonics Design Engineer - III/V Components
description:

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards deployment, you'll have real ownership of your area and work alongside a highly technical team on a hard problem in AI infrastructure.

The role 

You'll join a multi-disciplinary research team in the UK to lead the development of III-V active components for integration with silicon photonics. You will take devices from epitaxial stack and device design through fabrication with external partners, to characterisation, reliability and qualification.

What you'll be doing 

- Lead the design and modelling of III-V active devices, including epitaxial layer structure, gain and power modelling, optical mode design, and electrical and thermal design

- Own the technology roadmap and device specifications for your area, translating system requirements into device design and integration targets

- Lead mask design and tape-outs, including GDS layouts, test structures and design-of-experiment splits

- Manage fabrication runs with external epitaxy and foundry partners: define process flows, review process and in-line data, and resolve yield issues as the technology scales

- Define and lead the characterisation strategy at wafer, chip and integrated-PIC level, including building and automating test setups

- Analyse test data, correlate measured performance with design and process variations, and drive design iterations to close performance gaps

- Work with packaging and reliability engineers on burn-in, accelerated ageing, failure analysis and qualification

- Mentor engineers and, as the team grows, help recruit and develop new team members

Essential requirements 

- PhD in physics, photonics, electrical engineering, optical engineering or a related subject with 6+ years' relevant experience, or a Master's degree with 8+ years' relevant experience, including at least 4 years' hands-on development of III-V optical amplifiers or semiconductor lasers, preferably in industry

- Proven track record of taking III-V devices from concept through design, fabrication and test, ideally including qualification

- Deep understanding of semiconductor laser and amplifier physics: optical gain, carrier dynamics, quantum-well design, noise, gain saturation and nonlinearities, thermal effects and polarisation dependence

- Hands-on knowledge of III-V epitaxy and fabrication processes (e.g. MOCVD/MBE growth, lithography, etching, passivation, metallisation, facet/AR coating), and experience working with external foundries

- Experience characterising amplifiers or lasers, including optical spectrum analysis, gain and noise measurement, wafer-level probing, temperature-controlled testing and test automation

- Experience with simulation and layout tools for photonic devices, such as Lumerical, Photon Design, Crosslight, RSoft, COMSOL, KLayout, L-Edit or Cadence Virtuoso

- Proven ability to lead technical projects across design, process, test and packaging functions, and experience mentoring or supervising engineers

- Excellent communication skills, critical thinking, attention to detail and self-motivation

Nice to have 

- Experience integrating III-V active devices with silicon photonics, including coupling design between III-V and silicon waveguides

- Experience line-managing a technical team

- Experience with reliability testing and failure analysis of III-V devices

- Experience developing PDK building blocks or compact models for active devices

- Programming experience (Python, MATLAB or C++) for simulation, test automation and data analysis

- Knowledge of photonic packaging, including fibre coupling, thermal design and TEC control

- A track record of high-quality patents and research papers

description:
Description

Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

This job might be for you if youâve gotâ¦

- Experience as a Data Scientist (or a similar role) and can back it up with a resume that shows real results. Youâve built predictive models, optimized AI applications, and refined data architectures that have had a measurable impact. You donât just analyze numbersâyou translate data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.
- Serious coding skills in Python or R. You know how to build and refine machine learning models that actually work. Youâve used statistical modeling and data science tools to solve complex problems and unlock growth opportunities.
- Expertise in SQL and relational databases. Writing efficient queries? Optimizing data structures? Your resume is packed with quantifiable examples thatâll make us drool with desire! You know how to work with large datasets, ensuring data is organized, accessible, and primed for analysis.
- A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms. Whether itâs regression, clustering, or neural networks, you know how to choose the right approach for the right challenge. You donât just apply modelsâyou understand how they work under the hood.
- Hands-on experience with data warehouses. BigQuery or similar? Check. You understand how to design, maintain, and optimize scalable data storage solutions that support robust analytics.
- A knack for standardizing and improving data models. Youâve worked with data at scale, refining schemas and improving architectures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and usability across the organization.
- A laser-sharp eye for detail. Youâre the kind of person who spots trends, outliers, and opportunities that others miss. Your ability to catch anomalies helps ensure our models and analytics are always on point.
- An entrepreneurial approach to data. You donât just crunch numbersâyou think strategically about how data can be leveraged to create business value. Youâre proactive in identifying new ways AI and machine learning can drive efficiency, sales, and profitability.
- Industry know-how that adds value. If youâve got experience in consumer packaged goods, e-commerce, or the health/supplement industry, thatâs a huge plus. You understand how data can shape customer experience, optimize operations, and maximize ROI.
Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If youâre nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we canât wait to meet you.

Other Qualities Youâll Need

At AlgaeCal weâre going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

The truth is, if you donât have these qualities you wonât last long at AlgaeCal. So if youâre missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. Letâs talk about salary once weâve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, weâre generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, weâll make sure the compensation reflects that.

Youâll also enjoy the following benefits:

- Weekly team lunches

- Incredible dog friendly, Yaletown office one block from SkyTrain
- Remote working is okay with us too.
And above all, youâll join a team that youâll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many peopleâs lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply

Job opportunities like this donât come along often, and weâve got a lot to offer our successful applicant. So, to make sure our future Associate Data Scientist is the real-deal, will be a great fit, and will thrive at AlgaeCal, we ask a little more than your run-of-the-mill job application:

Yes, our hiring process is challenging, but itâs our way of selecting the best--and your way of ensuring your AlgaeCal teammates are tops.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves.

HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD 

GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

- You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

- You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

- You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

- You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence.

- You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early.

- You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster.

- You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts. You take ownership, show initiative when things aren’t yet clear and think from the customer’s problem. You enjoy helping others move forward without taking over. And you like working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like.

- Extensive experience in software or ML engineering, around 5 years or more. Depth in recent projects counts for more than the number of years.

- In-depth knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries.

- You’ve built LLM applications and run them in production.

- Solid experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or similar orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer setup (RAG) isn’t enough.

- You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

- Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases.

- Experience with Kubernetes.

- Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR 

On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. What colleagues value most here: mutual trust, room to experiment, and a team that helps each other out when someone gets stuck.

- A place where you have influence from day one: on the approach, the processes, and the direction.

- Colleagues who deliberately chose Lefebvre Sdu over big tech jobs because here, they're building something that doesn't exist yet.

- Base salary between €5,500 and €6,450 per month, based on a 36-hour week, since that's full-time for us. Plus a lot of extra allowances (see below).

- A bonus tied to company performance: a fixed year-end bonus of 4% and profit sharing of up to 6%.

- 23 vacation days and a personal choice budget of 12%, of which 8% is holiday pay and 4% is freely allocable. Want more vacation? Just buy it.

- A bonus of up to 10% of your salary, based on company performance and individual performance.

- A solid pension plan through PGB, including supplementary partner insurance.

- Collective insurance plans.

- A travel allowance of €0.25 per kilometer or a public transport reimbursement, plus an attractive bike plan. For employees with a commute of less than 10 km or more than 60 km, we have an adjusted arrangement.

- Two days a week in the office in The Hague, within walking distance of Voorburg station. The rest of the week, wherever you work best.

- Room to grow: in your craft, in your role, in the organization.

Want to know more? 

We’d love to tell you all about the team and the role. Send us your CV and you’ll hear from us within 5 working days. Any questions first? Message or call Nadine on 06 28556265.

A reference check and a VOG (certificate of good behaviour) are part of the selection process.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Product 

In a rapidly evolving world, trust in AI depends on AI agents being grounded in fresh, verified real-world data. Search is the foundation that makes this possible.

We are building an agent-native search platform designed specifically for AI systems rather than human users. Our product provides programmatic, low-latency, and observable search APIs that AI agents use to retrieve, filter, and reason over real-world information at scale.

The Role 

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the web access infrastructure behind a novel search engine designed for agentic AI.

In this role, you will investigate how modern websites communicate with browsers and translate that understanding into production systems operating at internet scale. You will build browser infrastructure and tooling that enables reliable, efficient access to web content across a rapidly changing web.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Research and analyse how modern websites communicate with browsers across the complete request lifecycle

- Investigate browser fingerprinting, client verification mechanisms, and modern web technologies to enable reliable web access

- Build tooling for browser instrumentation, debugging, observability, and large-scale experimentation

- Translate technical research into production systems operating at internet scale

Requirements 

You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on production backend or infrastructure systems, and are an expert in several of the following areas:

Browser Technologies 

- Chromium architecture and browser internals

- Browser lifecycle and navigation

- Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)

- Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or similar browser automation frameworks

- Browser instrumentation and debugging

Web Platform 

- HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, HTTP/3 — TLS, DNS, and browser networking

- Cookies, browser storage, caching, redirects, and session management

- JavaScript execution and modern client-side rendering

- Resource loading, page lifecycle, and browser networking

- Browser fingerprinting concepts and browser characteristics

Nice to Have 

- Experience working on browser engines or browser infrastructure

- Experience reverse engineering browser or web application behaviour

- Experience building internet-scale distributed systems

- Go, C++, Rust, or Python

- Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process. 

Benefits & Perks: 

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

title: Platform Engineer
description:
About Augur 

Augur transforms legacy sensor systems into real-time operational intelligence. We help organisations act before threats escalate – not after damage is done. Everything we build is privacy-first by design.

Our platform connects to existing cameras and sensors to detect threats, retrace events, and surface real-time insights – all without replacing a single device. Augur helps teams reduce risk, cut costs, and grow revenue through better visibility, faster decisions, and fewer blind spots.

Our culture is built on a foundation of radical candor and mutual trust. We recognise that being an industry leader requires more than just building exceptional products – it requires empowering a team of exceptional people. Individually, we operate with high autonomy; collectively, we’re unified by a shared drive to achieve our mission through a commitment to excellence.

The Role 

As a Platform Engineer at Augur, you will be responsible for the availability, performance, and scalability of our critical systems. You will bridge the gap between software development and IT operations by applying a software engineering mindset to system administration. 

● System Architecture and Design: Design, build, and maintain the core infrastructure that runs our platforms. Develop scalable, secure and highly reliable systems to support our services. 
● Automation and Tooling: Automate manual operational tasks, including deployment, monitoring, and incident response. Develop and maintain tools to improve efficiency and reduce the potential for human error. 
● Software Development: Write and review code (Ansible, Terraform, Python) for infrastructure automation, monitoring tools, and system improvements. Contribute to the development lifecycle to ensure reliability is built into our products from the start. 
● Performance and Reliability: Proactively monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to ensure high availability and low latency. Fill in the gaps in monitoring systems when observed. 
● Incident Management: Participate in an on-call rotation to respond to production incidents. Lead incident response, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventative measures to avoid future occurrences. 
● Capacity Planning: Analyse system usage, cost and performance data to make informed decisions about resource allocation. Forecast future infrastructure needs and scale our systems accordingly. 
● Collaboration and Best Practices: Work closely with software development teams to promote reliability best practices. Champion a culture of reliability across the engineering organisation. 
● Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date documentation for all systems, processes, and operational procedures as a core part of everyday work. Treat documentation as a first-class engineering deliverable.

Accessibility and inclusivity 

At Augur, our culture is built on radical candor and mutual trust. To solve the complex, physical-world problems our customers face, we need a team that thinks differently. 

Whether you’re self-taught, have a non-traditional background, or are returning to the workforce, if you have the grit and the experience we’re looking for at Augur, we’d love to hear from you. 

We are committed to fostering a diverse workplace and ensuring an accessible hiring experience - please let us know if you require any accommodations during the interview process to help you do your best work.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Software Engineer - Mexico
description:
About ElevenLabs 


ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.


We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.


We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:



- 
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.




- 
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.




- 
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.





Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.



How we work



- 
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.




- 
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.




- 
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.




- 
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.




- 
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.





What we offer



- 
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.




- 
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.




- 
Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.




- 
Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.




- 
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.




- 
Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.





This role is remote, so it can be executed globally. 


About the role 


You’ll use your creativity, problem-solving, and technical expertise to design tailored solutions that make a real impact.


Embedded with our most strategic customers, you’ll get a front-row seat to some of our highest-stakes projects. From brainstorming technical architectures and product features to building full-scale integrations, you’ll take full ownership of complex, high-impact challenges—helping clients achieve their goals and push the limits of what’s possible.


What you will do:



- 
Take full ownership of end-to-end execution of major projects for our most strategic partners, working hands-on to deliver high-impact solutions.




- 
Collaborate daily with our customer’s engineers and executives teams to ensure the best use of ElevenLabs’ technologies.




- 
Drive real innovation by using your coding and technical skills to solve complex problems, making a real difference for our customers.





Requirements 



- 
Experience working with customers. It’s ok if you only worked with customers in student clubs or side projects, as long as you are interested in working closely with them on a technical capacity




- 
Proficiency in Python and strong software development knowledge, inclusive of a deep understanding of software development, software architecture, and APIs integration.




- 
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills. Especially in terms of ability to summarize complex technical knowledge and using logic in pursuing optimal solutions.





Location 



- 
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Mexico, with a preference of Mexico City. Expect regular travel for customer onsites. Fluency in English and Spanish and a deep understanding of the regional and cultural nuances is required.

title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

- Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events

- Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them

- Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading

- Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise

- Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible

- Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales

- Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models

- Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper

- Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems

- Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.

- Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning

- No active backlogs

- Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++

- Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects

- Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking

- A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly

Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.

Our Culture

More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.

At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.

Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

AI & Automation stage beschikbaar!

Wij brengen zakelijke en particuliere klanten naar het evenement van hun dromen. Jij kunt hier onderdeel van uitmaken in de vorm van een stage bij ons Finance team. Feeling met sport? Dan wordt deze stage je grootste hobby! 

Hoe gaat je stage eruitzien? 
In deze rol werk je samen met verschillende afdelingen om operationele behoeften te identificeren, te begrijpen hoe teams werken, en die inzichten te vertalen naar praktische automatiseringsoplossingen en AI-agents. 

Als AI & Automation Intern ondersteun je de ontwikkeling van tools die de efficiëntie binnen het bedrijf verbeteren, van workflows in Power Automate tot AI-agents gebouwd in Microsoft Foundry en script-gebaseerde oplossingen. Deze helpen medewerkers om informatie te raadplegen, content te genereren, documenten te verwerken en repetitieve taken efficiënter uit te voeren. Je werkt nauw samen met teams zoals Finance, HR, Operations, Partnerships, Marketing en Ticketing om hun dagelijkse processen te begrijpen en te bepalen waar automatisering echte waarde kan toevoegen. 

Een belangrijk onderdeel van de functie is goed begrijpen hoe elke afdeling werkt. Dat betekent de juiste vragen stellen, assertief zijn in het verzamelen van de informatie die je nodig hebt, en gedurende elk project duidelijk blijven communiceren met stakeholders. 

Deze rol is geschikt voor iemand die nieuwsgierig is naar bedrijfsprocessen, zelfverzekerd communiceert met verschillende stakeholders, en gedreven is om eigenaarschap te nemen van idee tot implementatie. De functie combineert technische interesse met sterke projectmanagementvaardigheden: je verzamelt relevante informatie, structureert workflows, bouwt oplossingen, test de resultaten, verbetert deze op basis van feedback, en traint eindgebruikers zodat de automatiseringen en agents goed worden geadopteerd zodra ze live staan. 

Jouw profiel 

- Je volgt een hbo- of wo-opleiding (bijv. bedrijfskunde, informatica, information management, AI of een vergelijkbare richting) en bent beschikbaar voor een meewerkstage.

- Naast Nederlands beheers je ook de Engelse taal. 

- Mooi meegenomen als je zelf ook een passie hebt voor sport, dat hebben wij namelijk ook! 

Waar kom je terecht? 

We zijn gevestigd in het mooie Leiden en je komt terecht in een gezellig én ambitieus bedrijf waar geen dag hetzelfde is. We bestaan momenteel uit een groep van 70 collega’s en werken elk semester met een leuke groep van stagiaires verdeeld over verschillende afdelingen. Je zult dus zeker niet de enige zijn die in februari 2027 van start gaat. 

Dit krijg jij ervoor terug! 

Naast een afwisselende stage en goede begeleiding wordt er verder goed voor je gezorgd. Denk hierbij aan een gaaf kantoor voorzien van alle gemakken, verzorgde lunch, sportmogelijkheden en de vetste uitjes met de hele toko. ''It’s all about unforgettable experiences!''

title: Computational Chemist (gn) @ Chemistry AI Venture, London
description:
This an Atlantic portfolio venture. 

About the Venture 

This early-stage venture is building a discovery engine for chemistry, comprising a platform for running end-to-end simulations of chemical reaction systems, and a world model + agent stack that uses the simulation platform to discover new chemistry.

Their goal is to build backend scientific data infrastructure to meet the demands of AI systems that can truly accelerate and automate the discovery layer of chemistry.

Both founders hold PhDs in Chemistry from the University of Oxford, and the venture has already secured pre-seed funding. They are now building out their founding team.

The Role 

- As a Computational Chemist, you will play a central role in shaping the scientific foundations of the venture's technology, helping develop the computational methods and workflows that underpin its end-to-end chemical reaction simulation platform.

- You’ll work closely with researchers and engineers to integrate state-of-the-art computational chemistry methods with machine learning approaches, driving progress towards the venture's strategic and scientific objectives.

- You’ll take ownership of developing, validating and optimising the computational chemistry components of the platform, with a particular focus on reaction mechanisms, reaction kinetics, molecular dynamics and the modelling of complex chemical environments.

- You will design, implement and refine scalable scientific workflows for generating, processing and analysing chemical reaction data, improving the accuracy, reliability and computational efficiency of simulations.

- Beyond your core scientific responsibilities, the team is looking for someone who can contribute to strategic research decisions, bring strong independent scientific judgement, and help shape the interdisciplinary research culture of the company at an early stage.

What You'll Work On 

- Foundation models for chemical reactivity: The team is building and training foundation models for chemical reactivity with a variety of data modalities. You'll help curate this foundational data corpus by developing cheminformatics and computational chemistry workflows for generating data from combinatorial enumeration, as well as robust data filtering, clustering and validation routines.
